purpose: Source-bounded ceiling and routing contract for maximizing zero-dollar Buildkite plus Oracle Cloud execution after trial expiry.

truth_boundary.rule: Provider documentation defines plan ceilings; actual account quotas, agents, queues, capacity and eligibility still require authenticated provider readback.

equivalent_continuous_allocation.note: Fits a 31-day month: 2*24*31=1488 OCPU-hours and 12*24*31=8928 GB-hours.

recommended_ci_topologies: one 2-OCPU/12-GB worker for strongest single-job throughput
two 1-OCPU/6-GB workers for isolation and two-way concurrency

amd_micro.recommended_role: lightweight control, monitoring or tiny compatibility work only

conditions_all_required: memory utilization below 20 percent for A1
idle_reclamation.policy: Do not generate synthetic load solely to evade reclamation; run useful workloads and treat reclamation as a provider lifecycle constraint.

queue_model.role: bounded burst/x86 fallback consuming the monthly hosted allowance

routing_law: Use one Buildkite cluster and multiple queues; do not spend the Free plan's single-cluster allowance on topology duplication.
Prefer self-hosted compute for routine CI because it does not consume the 2000 hosted Linux vCPU-minute allowance.
Use hosted Linux only when self-hosted capacity is unavailable, incompatible or intentionally isolated.
Do not route to hosted macOS on Free because it is unavailable.
Never promote oracle-arm64 to authoritative default until a live exact-SHA Buildkite plus Oracle receipt and GitHub projection exist.
Persist durable receipts outside Buildkite because Free build and artifact retention is 30 days.
Keep total Buildkite concurrency at or below 10 jobs even when several queues are healthy.

apex_control_plane.finding: valid portable hosted rail but not zero-dollar-optimal as routine default because it consumes the finite hosted Linux allowance

genius_family_reconciler.finding: self-hosted and therefore compatible with Free economics if the Mac agent is live

oracle_runner.finding: the intended zero-dollar Linux execution lane exists in source but was never promoted through a live provider receipt

next_state.objective: Make Buildkite a one-cluster scheduler over operator-owned compute, with Oracle A1 as the primary Linux worker once proven, macOS self-hosted for platform-specific work, and hosted Linux as metered free burst capacity.
required_live_readback: current Buildkite plan and service quotas
current monthly hosted Linux vCPU-minute usage
OCI home region and current service-limit readback
existing A1 and E2 instance shapes, OCPUs, memory and lifecycle state
exact Oracle worker Buildkite registration and proof build
